problems: validateInputParameters() in subworkflows/local/utils_nfcore_ampliseq_pipeline/main.nf stops the run with an error when `--skip_dada_quality` is set and either `--trunclenf` or `--trunclenr` is null: "Incompatible parameters: `--skip_dada_quality` may not be used without setting `--trunclenf` and `--trunclenr`." The baseline test profile sets neither, so the pipeline aborts at initialisation and no process runs. The reason for this check is that the baseline picks truncation lengths automatically: TRUNCLEN reads the DADA2_QUALITY1 quality-stats table, and that table no longer exists once quality profiling is skipped. To skip profiling, the researcher must also choose explicit `--trunclenf`/`--trunclenr` values. Doing so would change DADA2 filtering and every downstream result.
rationale: Skipping DADA2 quality profiling maps to `--skip_dada_quality true`. With the baseline configuration this is rejected during parameter validation, because no explicit truncation lengths are set and the automatic truncation (TRUNCLEN) depends on the DADA2_QUALITY1 output. The run fails before any task executes, so no process changes are listed.
